channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Youth Vaping Drops While Smoke-Free Alternatives Gain Ground Among Arizona Adults
item.description: Arizona's adult smoking rate has fallen to a historic low of 7.7%, while vaping now exceeds smoking among adults for the first time. At the same time, youth vaping has declined substantially over the past decade, according to newly released survey data. (Published on October 28, 2026bythr101.org)

item.title: Illegal Market Exaggerated
item.description: The scale of Britain's illicit cigarette market is under renewed scrutiny, with Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) challenging industry-funded estimates that suggest 45% of cigarettes consumed are illegal, compared with HMRC's estimate of 12%. (Published on October 28, 2026byplanetofthevapes.co.uk)

item.title: E-cigarettes help smokers quit even without specialist support, randomized trial finds
item.description: A new randomised controlled trial involving 1,170 adults has found that e-cigarettes can help smokers quit even without specialist behavioural support. (Published on October 28, 2026bymedicalxpress.com)

item.title: When the Data Point to Price but the Answer is still Enforcement.
item.description: Illicit tobacco use has risen sharply among two disadvantaged populations in Australia, with a new study identifying price as the main motivation. Illegal cigarettes were reportedly selling for a fraction of the legal retail price, creating strong financial incentives to purchase outside regulated channels. (Published on October 28, 2026bysubstack.com)
